avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer; significantly reduces primidone levels and anticonvulsant efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may require seizure threshold monitoring if discontinuation necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; combined CNS depression with primidone increases sedation and impairs cognition
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative supplements with lower hepatotoxic potential

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; may potentiate sedation, ataxia, and psychomotor impairment
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with extreme caution; counsel on increased fall risk and cognitive effects

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Primidone increases metabolism of vitamin D; deficiency impairs bone health and seizure control
caution_supplements.action: Monitor 25-OH vitamin D levels; consider supplementation (400-2000 IU daily) with periodic monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Calcium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Primidone impairs calcium absorption; may contribute to bone loss and increased fracture risk
caution_supplements.action: Ensure adequate intake (1000-1200 mg daily) and coordinate timing 2+ hours from primidone doses

caution_supplements.name: Folic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Primidone increases folate metabolism; deficiency linked to anemia and poor seizure control
caution_supplements.action: Monitor CBC and homocysteine; supplement with 1-5 mg daily as indicated by lab values

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K
caution_supplements.mechanism: Primidone may reduce vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis; increases bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor INR if on anticoagulants; ensure adequate leafy greens intake; supplement if deficient

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases primidone levels and risk of toxicity, ataxia, and dizziness
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; counsel on symptom recognition; monitor for overdose signs

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay primidone absorption and alter peak drug levels; inconsistent seizure control timing
caution_foods.action: Take primidone with consistent meal composition and timing; avoid large lipid loads at dosing time

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Indole compounds may modestly induce CYP3A4; may marginally reduce primidone levels with excessive consumption
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation as part of balanced diet; maintain consistent intake patterns

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Potentiates CNS depression; increases sedation, ataxia, cognitive impairment, and seizure risk
caution_foods.action: Strongly discourage consumption; counsel on seizure threshold reduction and fall hazards

monitoring_notes: Primidone is a potent enzyme inducer requiring comprehensive monitoring of bone health (vitamin D, calcium, alkaline phosphatase), hematologic parameters (CBC for folate deficiency anemia), and anticonvulsant efficacy due to multiple drug interactions. Patients should maintain consistent dietary patterns and avoid herbal inducers; counsel on CNS depression risks with alcohol and sedating supplements.
